No. On 1 December 2026 the Directive 2006/42/EC still governs, and under its Art. 12(4) a non-harmonised Annex IV machine may only use EC type-examination (Annex IX) or full quality assurance (Annex X). Unit verification (module G) is not admitted; the Regulation that lists it applies only from 20 January 2027.

The facts do not say which Annex IV categories are listed in Annex I Part A or Part B, so they cannot show which categories lose module A on 1 February 2027. The Directive is repealed from 20 January 2027 and the Regulation applies from that date (Corrigendum points 5 and 10), and Annex I Part B categories keep module A (Art. 25(3)).
